content: PRIMARY-VERIFIED (wheel index HTML + readthedocs): llama-cpp-python prebuilt wheels at abetlen.github.io/llama-cpp-python/whl/<backend>; 0.3.36 cpu/metal/cu121 all py3-none platform wheels (CORRECTS stale 'GPU stops cp312' lead — that applied to older cp-tagged builds; docs still say 3.10-3.12). cu121 0.3.36 = manylinux_2_35_x86_64 only; metal = macosx_11_0_arm64; cpu covers win_amd64. pip install --extra-index-url <index>. pip wheel cache keys on version not CMAKE_ARGS -> --force-reinstall --no-cache-dir when switching backends. macOS arm64 Python required else 10x slower.
